name: Yumemiru Ginka ~Case of the quartette~
original_name: 夢見る銀貨 ～Case of the quartette～
source:
Main character returns to his hometown. He sees gentle slopes and familiar early summer sunshine again. He reunites with three childhood friends after 10 years time. But he... lost all memories about this town.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
